decisions.reason: As a close-to-core handle family in a growing market, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and a large firm with product-range slack would usually retain it unless overlap within the assortment clearly underperforms.

This design-focused but still core product is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning if its sales lag comparable handle lines, yet its fit with the established business makes continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Because the electronic access system is a flagship product aligned with the firm's stated move toward digital building organisation, management would likely tolerate short-run uncertainty and keep it unless results fell well below aspirations.
